title: [NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis](http://www.matthe
summary: A JAX reimplementation of NeRF that trains 1M optimization steps on 128 TPUv2 cores in about 2.5 hours (versus roughly 3 days for the TF version) and renders an 800x800 view in 2.65 seconds on 8 V100s. Meridian is productizing it as the rendering core for immersive product previews.
